author: xzsamurai
quote: Rockstar Games failed to deliver a proper GTA title for longtime fans like me. Aside from its excellent visuals, the game features a soulless world that offers no pull to keep playing after the first few hours. The characters feel empty, especially Lucia, and you basically have to be an errand boy and satisfy her throughout the entire game just to proceed with the storyline. The plot is boring and pointless, with no memorable moments at all. Instead, the game forces you to do completely meaningless tasks right from the very beginning.Back when GTA V was announced, Rockstar released an extensive gameplay trailer. They skipped doing that for GTA VI because they knew it plays more like The Sims, with everything feeling overly sanitized and restricted. This is not a true GTA game, and the direction Rockstar Games is heading is truly disappointing. It feels like a game written by people outside of Rockstar Games that shares nothing with true GTA DNA at all.I do not recommend this game at all, and I am in the process of getting a refund. I cannot remember the last time I was this disappointed by an entertainment product. 13 years completely wasted.
